name: Markers note, strong lines outside the markers
about: A note written with "Slide N:" markers makes its first deck from the markers alone: what sits outside them stays words. Once the deck is made, a line outside the markers that the structure rules read strongly is offered as an Add: a labelled line ("Next step:", a labelled point), a scripture reference with its verse, a quote, a bold-only line in a note that mixes bold. Plain talk stays notes either way (`liveAdds`).

runs.text: Hi team, here are my slides for Sunday.
Idols promise what only God can give.
That's when I think about my grandfather's farm.
Next step: Write down one idol you'll hand back to God this week.
25 They exchanged the truth about God for a lie.
Idols are good things made ultimate.
So take a quiet moment with that this week.
